baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence رَفَعَ + سَمْكَهَا + فَسَوَّىٰهَا as one physical construction operation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Physical elevation lifts the sky's roof or supporting span; the result marker ف then makes straightening and completion follow from raising, so height and integrity belong to one staged act.

activation_trace.role: Physical lifting supplies the upward construction step.
The roof and building-support image identifies the raised object as an overhead structural span.
Straightness and completion supply the finishing operation that makes the raised span whole.

changed_reading.before: A bare report that its height was raised and it was fashioned.
changed_reading.after: A staged building act: an overhead span is lifted into place and then brought to structural straightness and completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَمْكَهَا as vertical extent and سَوَّىٰهَا as equivalence or proportion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object is not merely moved upward: its vertical dimension is established and then calibrated. The repeated feminine pronoun keeps elevation and equalization on the same object.

activation_trace.role: Lifting establishes the upward extent that will be measured.
Height and ascent make the object's vertical span the measured dimension.
Equality and equivalence turn the second verb into proportional calibration rather than generic finishing.

changed_reading.before: Raising is the main act and leveling is an unspecific completion.
changed_reading.after: The line establishes a lofty span and subjects that very span to matched measure and proportion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَفَعَ as elevation of rank, held to the physical height of سَمْك and the just middle of سَوَّىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Literal height permits a status activation, but the final balancing branch constrains elevation by measure: legitimate highness is ordered rather than self-asserted.

activation_trace.role: Elevation of rank supplies a status register alongside physical raising.
Literal height keeps the status activation tethered to the focus object's vertical extent.
The middle, equity, and just-place image makes measure the condition of this highness.

changed_reading.before: The focus speaks only about physical altitude.
changed_reading.after: It can also image a highness whose legitimacy lies in being established within balance and measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding building verb activates the roof-and-support branch of سَمْك: 79:28 now reads as the elevation and finishing stages internal to an already named act of construction.

activation_trace.role: Physical lifting becomes a specific stage of construction.
The roof or supporting member supplies the architectural object being installed.
Straightening and completion supply the structural finish.
Building by joining parts frames the focus sequence as component assembly rather than isolated elevation.

structural_cues: 79:27 ends with a building verb whose feminine object pronoun is carried directly into the three pronouns of 79:28.
The ف in فَسَوَّىٰهَا makes finishing follow the elevation step.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies building-by-joining and a contiguous pronoun chain; I infer that raising the samk names a construction stage within that building process. A live alternative is that 79:28 restates majestic height without implying assembly.

changed_reading.before: The focus could describe elevation and completion without fixing an architectural frame.
changed_reading.after: It specifies how the preceding building occurs: the overhead member is raised, aligned, and completed as a coherent structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied return earlier in the surah and the explicit creation comparison immediately before the focus convert its two operations into evidence: producing a vast ordered structure supplies an analogical answer to doubt about reconstitution.

activation_trace.role: The concrete lifting operation supplies observable constructive capacity.
Completion after deformation supplies the focus-side image of ordered formation.
Return to a former state supplies the disputed reconstitution that the focus sequence answers.
Bringing creation into existence marks the sky construction as the comparison case in the argument.

structural_cues: 79:10-14 stages an objection to return and answers it with sudden restored presence.
79:27 asks which creation is harder and immediately answers by narrating the sky's construction in 79:27-29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denied return, a harder-creation question, and the focus's constructive operations; I supply the analogical arrow from demonstrated cosmic construction to possible reconstitution. The live alternative is a general display of power rather than a step in the resurrection argument.

changed_reading.before: The line is a descriptive detail about the sky.
changed_reading.after: The lifting and perfecting of the sky is performed evidence: large-scale ordered creation answers disbelief in being formed again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah realizes completion through controlled difference rather than flat sameness: darkness is imposed, brightness is brought from concealment, and the completed sky becomes an ordered alternator of visible states.

activation_trace.role: The elevated span supplies the celestial domain in which the alternation operates.
Equivalence and calibration allow completion to be read as regulated relation between contrasting states.
Darkening the night supplies one deliberately produced state of the system.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition into the contrasting state.
The brightness and clarity of morning supply the visible counter-state to darkness.

structural_cues: 79:29 pairs two causative verbs over night and morning while retaining the same feminine sky pronoun.
The paired darkness and brightness follow immediately after فَسَوَّىٰهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a completed elevated span followed by produced darkness and emergent brightness; I infer that functional regulation is one effect of its taswiya. A live alternative is that taswiya remains purely structural and 79:29 begins a separate list of acts.

changed_reading.before: Taswiya is static geometric leveling or generic completion.
changed_reading.after: Taswiya can include calibrating the sky as an operating order whose balance appears through the managed alternation of darkness and brightness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The raised upper span is paired with the lower earth, then with anchoring and practical benefit. This turns roof, ground, and stabilizers into one vertical environmental arrangement rather than independent feats.

activation_trace.role: Lifting supplies the upper boundary of the environmental arrangement.
The roof and support image makes the sky the overhead side of an inhabited enclosure.
Completion makes the upper structure fit for participation in the larger system.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the system's complementary ground plane.
Firm fixation supplies stability on the terrestrial side of the arrangement.
Useful provision supplies the functional end toward which the completed arrangement works.

structural_cues: 79:30-32 alternate earth, its extracted water and pasture, and fixed mountains after the sky sequence.
79:33 closes the sequence by assigning its products as provision for humans and livestock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upper roof, a lower earth, terrestrial stability, resources, and utility; I infer integration into a habitable vertical system. A live alternative is a serial inventory of benefits without a single enclosure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: 79:28 is a self-contained account of sky construction.
changed_reading.after: The raised and completed span is the upper component of a stable, provision-bearing habitat coordinated with earth below.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh's earlier claim to be highest activates the focus's rank branch, while سَوَّىٰ constrains elevation by balance. The actual cosmic raising therefore forms a counter-image to self-declared, unmeasured supremacy.

activation_trace.role: Elevation of rank allows the physical raising to carry a controlled status resonance.
Literal height keeps the status contrast grounded in the focus object's real verticality.
Justice, centeredness, and the middle constrain highness by ordered measure.
Self-asserted greatness and domination supply the rival form of highness against which ordered elevation is read.

structural_cues: 79:17 names Pharaoh's transgression, 79:24 voices his claim to highest lordship, and 79:25 narrates his seizure.
The cosmic construction follows the narrative lesson without another human claimant to height.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Pharaoh's claim of highest status, his downfall, and then actual cosmic raising; I infer a polemical contrast between self-exaltation and measured elevation. A live alternative is that the narrative and creation proof are adjacent without this lexical counterpoint.

changed_reading.before: The focus's vertical language has no social or sovereign pressure.
changed_reading.after: Its measured cosmic highness quietly reallocates supremacy away from a ruler's unbounded claim and toward an order he neither raises nor controls.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later question about the Hour's mooring and statement of its endpoint put temporal bounds around the completed sky: present stability is an established interval, not self-perpetuating permanence.

activation_trace.role: The completed roof supplies the apparently stable created order whose duration is reconsidered.
Completion supplies achieved order without itself guaranteeing endless duration.
A vessel's stopping and mooring gives the Hour an appointed arrival image that bounds the current order.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies an explicit terminus beyond the sky's present completion.

structural_cues: The surah moves from a completed sky to asking when the Hour will be moored and locating its endpoint with the Lord.
The repeated feminine suffix in سَوَّىٰهَا, مُرْسَىٰهَا, and مُنتَهَىٰهَا creates a formal echo while the referents differ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a finished sky, an Hour with a mooring, and an endpoint; I infer that cosmic completion describes a bounded stable phase. A live alternative is that the repeated suffix and stability language are formal echoes with no backward effect on 79:28.

changed_reading.before: The completed span appears as a timelessly settled structure.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a calibrated but finite order: fully established now, yet held within an appointed temporal terminus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads construction through the focus's form-distant travel and orientation branches. It remains anchored in رَفَعَ, سَمْك, and سَوَّىٰ and is activated by the opening sequence of movement, precedence, and governance; downstream prose should present it only as a procedural or rhythmic activation, not claim that the opening agents are identified as the sky's builders.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَفَعَ as intensified travel and سَوَّىٰ as orientation toward a goal, held against the literal verticality of سَمْك.

activation_trace.role: Intensified travel turns raising into a dynamic ascent rather than a frozen height.
Vertical height gives the dynamic path a specifically upward axis.
Approach and orientation toward a direction supply a directed settling phase.
Running or swimming supplies sustained traversal in the opening kinetic sequence.
Precedence supplies acceleration toward an ordered lead position.
Planning by regard for outcomes converts motion into governed process.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a static snapshot of a finished height.
changed_reading.after: It can be heard as controlled choreography: upward motion is driven, brought to its intended orientation, and settled into order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it maps cosmic geometry onto self-regulation. It remains anchored in the focus's genuine raising and straightening branches and in 79:40's uprightness and desire/fall branches; downstream prose should qualify it as an ethical analogy activated by the surah, not an etymological equation or the primary lexical sense of 79:28.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The upward رَفَعَ and straightening سَوَّىٰ sequence as a vertical contrast to standing in balance or falling along desire.

activation_trace.role: Physical raising supplies the upward pole of the ethical analogy.
Straightness and integrity supply the image of an ordered self.
Uprightness, balance, and evenness activate a human analogue to the focus's straightening.
Inclination of desire identifies the ethical force that must be restrained.
Falling into a depth supplies the branch-distant downward counter-image to cosmic raising.

changed_reading.before: Sky construction and restraint of desire occupy unrelated domains.
changed_reading.after: The raised-and-straightened cosmos can function analogically as the opposite of inward descent: ordered elevation images a self held upright against desire's pull.

strongest_changes: The prior building verb turns the focus into a precise roof-raising and finishing stage.
The denied return and harder-creation question make the focus an argument for reconstitution, not just description.
The following light cycle and earth provisions widen taswiya into regulated, habitable order.
Pharaoh's claim to be highest activates a contrast between self-exaltation and elevation constrained by measure.
summary.what_was_special: A four-word construction sentence became a hinge among architecture, proportion, resurrection evidence, sovereignty, ecological function, and bounded time without forcing those readings into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The functional light-cycle reading may exceed the immediate morphology of سَوَّىٰ and remain only a contextual revision.
The Pharaoh contrast and ethical verticality are discourse-level analogies rather than necessary lexical senses.
The Hour's mooring and endpoint may be a later formal echo rather than a backward qualification of cosmic completion.
